summary: A U.S. Senator has committed to prioritizing D.C. statehood, while advocacy groups continue pointing to federal interventions in the District as evidence for why local control matters. The headlines reference both a federal takeover and a National Guard deployment as recent events underscoring the case for statehood. Without statehood, D.C. does not control its own National Guard and cannot refuse the deployment of other states' troops within its borders.

articles.title: VIDEO: Senator Slotkin Commits to Making DC Statehood a Top Priority
One Year Later, DC Vote Says Federal Takeover Underscores the Urgency of DC Statehood
One Year After President Trump Deployed National Guard Troops to Washington, D.C., Statehood is More Important Than Ever
